description_en: Configures the global mitigation policy feature, including the feature status and settings
description_zh: 配置DDoS全局防护策略的开关和等级
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo config-domain-security-profile --domain example.aliyundoc.com --config '{"global_rule_mode":"hard"}' --cluster default --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigDomainSecurityProfile

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The configurations for the global mitigation policy feature. The configurations include the following fields:

global_rule_mode: optional. The mode for the global mitigation policy feature. Data type: string. Valid values:

    *   weak: loose.
    *   default: normal.
    *   hard: strict.

global_rule_enable: optional. Specifies whether to enable the global mitigation policy feature. Data type: string. Valid values:

    *   0: disabled.
    *   1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
配置网站业务DDoS全局防护策略，具体结构如下。
global_rule_mode：String类型，可选，DDoS全局防护功能的防护等级。取值：
    - weak：宽松
    - default：正常
    - hard：严格
global_rule_enable：integer类型，可选，DDoS全局防护功能的开关。取值：
    - 0：关闭
    - 1：开启

配置网站业务DDoS防护自定义防护策略黑/白名单防护策略功能，具体结构如下。
bwlist_enable：integer类型，可选，自定义防护策略黑/白名单开关。取值：
    - 0：关闭
    - 1：开启
